name: rad-para
description: An Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package for one-person PARA organization, reviews, summaries, and handoffs. It has no sync service or app connector and can misclassify sparse notes.

interface.shortDescription: Review and organize a local PARA note system.
interface.longDescription: RAD PARA is an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 package with Codex marketplace metadata for one-person PARA work. It provides organization guidance, read-only structural audits, weekly reviews, Progressive Summarization, output assembly, session handoffs, and a 12 Favorite Problems workshop. File moves require an approved plan. It has no sync engine, scheduler, or live app connector, and thin context can lead to wrong classifications.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up or repair my PARA second brain.
Audit my PARA folders and explain what needs attention.
Run a weekly PARA review briefing.
Apply progressive summarization to these notes.
